Callout.Name: Gate Damage - Ranch Entrance
Callout.Message: Ranch entrance gate pulled out of the ground.
Callout.Advisory: Tyre marks through the gateway, cattle out.

Script.Line: They took the gate off with a truck and kept going.
The cattle went straight up the lane and onto the road.
I heard it from the house. It sounded like a shot.

Lines.Approach: They took the gate off with a vehicle and the cattle are out on the road.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
